# Astilba Env

Preserve public exports, deterministic generated bytes and the published Node support matrix. Development Node and pnpm versions are separate from consumer runtime pins.

Run `pnpm verify:env` from the repository root. `pnpm verify:env:archive` packs and checks the exact npm archive; `.github/workflows/env-package-matrix.yml` runs it against every supported consumer. Tool resolution may use the shared pnpm store but must reject paths outside the installation root.

Registry examples live under `fixtures/registry/env` with their own installation, lockfile and registry pins. Use positive and negative controls for source identity, symlink containment, exports and generated output.

To release, bump `version` in `package.json`, merge, and push an `env/v<version>` tag on `main`. The workflow stages the release; it goes live once a maintainer approves it on npm with 2FA.
